title: Parcel Locker Platform
short_summary: Platform-level umbrella for the parcel-locker product, covering the physical lockers and the software that governs customer pickup.
long_summary: The parcel-locker platform is the top-level domain area for the product. It covers the physical lockers and the software governing how customers retrieve parcels. Specific subsystems hang underneath it. This topic stays deliberately broad and acts as the parent under which more specific areas are organized.
